model_annotation:
The line chart depicts a comparison of the performance of three different methods, labeled as lattice, FLAT, and OURS, across epochs, which are represented by the x-axis, ranging from 0 to 18 with a consistent scale. The y-axis measures the F1 score and varies from 0.55 to 0.90, also with a uniform scale.

The lattice method is represented by a line with square markers, starting at an F1 score of approximately 0.60 at epoch 2 and showing a relatively steady increase to reach an F1 score just below 0.80 by epoch 18. The FLAT method, indicated by a line with circular markers, begins at an F1 score of nearly 0.80 at epoch 2, with a slight increase to about 0.85 by epoch 18. The OURS method, shown as a line with triangular markers, starts at an F1 score of around 0.85 at epoch 2 and shows a significant increase to reach an F1 score of approximately 0.90 by epoch 18.

The data points for each method are marked at each epoch, with the FLAT method exhibiting a plateau at epoch 12, resulting in a flat trend up to epoch 18. All methods demonstrate an overall positive trend, indicating improvement in the F1 score as the number of epochs increases. However, the OURS method appears to perform the best, achieving the highest F1 score by the final epoch shown.
